{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kaarenth Impalers''' originally were the adamantly faithful protectors of the [[Paecian Empire]]. Millennia after its collapse, the title was reused by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], founder and head of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Palpatine dubbed [[Ennix Devian]] his personal "Karenth Impaler," tasking him with hunting down anyone he perceived as betraying their oath to him.
